title.hi: Internet Services — Search, Chat aur e-Services
title.en: Internet Services — Search, Chat and e-Services

headline.hi: Internet Sirf Websites Se Zyada Hai
headline.en: The Internet Is More Than Just Websites

subtext.hi: Search engines se lekar e-Banking tak — internet roz-marra ki zindagi mein kaise use hota hai.
subtext.en: From search engines to e-Banking — how the internet is used in everyday life.

content.hi: Information Retrieval aur Search Engines: Search Engines (jaise Google, Bing) websites ko index karke rakhte hain, taaki keywords search karne par relevant results turant mil jaayein. Ye information retrieval ka sabse common tarika hai.
content.en: Information Retrieval and Search Engines: Search Engines (like Google, Bing) index websites so that searching keywords instantly returns relevant results. This is the most common method of information retrieval.

content.hi: Finding People on the Net: Social networking sites, professional platforms (jaise LinkedIn), aur people-search directories logon ko dhoondhne mein help karte hain.
content.en: Finding People on the Net: Social networking sites, professional platforms (like LinkedIn), and people-search directories help locate people online.

content.hi: Web Services (communication): Chat (real-time text conversation), Email (asynchronous messages), Video Conferencing (live video calls, jaise Zoom/Google Meet).
content.en: Web Services (communication): Chat (real-time text conversation), Email (asynchronous messages), Video Conferencing (live video calls, like Zoom/Google Meet).

content.hi: e-Services (roz-marra life mein): e-Learning (online courses/classes), e-Banking (bank transactions online), e-Shopping (online kharidari, jaise Amazon), e-Reservation (tickets book karna, jaise IRCTC), e-Governance (government services online, jaise DigiLocker), e-Groups (common-interest online communities), Social Networking (Facebook, Instagram — connections aur content sharing).
content.en: e-Services (in everyday life): e-Learning (online courses/classes), e-Banking (bank transactions online), e-Shopping (online shopping, like Amazon), e-Reservation (booking tickets, like IRCTC), e-Governance (government services online, like DigiLocker), e-Groups (common-interest online communities), Social Networking (Facebook, Instagram — connections and content sharing).

problem.hi: In activities ko unki sahi e-Service category se match karo: (a) IRCTC se train ticket book karna, (b) DigiLocker se certificate download karna, (c) Amazon se kapde order karna, (d) NPTEL course lena.
problem.en: Match these activities to their correct e-Service category: (a) Booking a train ticket on IRCTC, (b) Downloading a certificate from DigiLocker, (c) Ordering clothes on Amazon, (d) Taking an NPTEL course.

question.hi: Websites index karke keyword search se relevant results dena kaunsa service hai?
question.en: Which service indexes websites and returns relevant results for keyword searches?

explanation.hi: Search Engines (Google, Bing) websites ko index karke keyword search par relevant results dete hain.
explanation.en: Search Engines (Google, Bing) index websites and return relevant results for keyword searches.

question.hi: Government services online avail karna (jaise DigiLocker) kaunsi e-Service kehlaati hai?
question.en: Availing government services online (like DigiLocker) is which e-Service?

explanation.hi: Government services online avail karna e-Governance kehlaata hai.
explanation.en: Availing government services online is called e-Governance.

notes.hi: Search Engine = websites index karke search results dena
notes.en: Search Engine = indexing websites to give search results

notes.hi: Communication services: Chat, Email, Video Conferencing
notes.en: Communication services: Chat, Email, Video Conferencing

notes.hi: e-Services: e-Learning, e-Banking, e-Shopping, e-Reservation, e-Governance, e-Groups, Social Networking
notes.en: e-Services: e-Learning, e-Banking, e-Shopping, e-Reservation, e-Governance, e-Groups, Social Networking

summary.hi: Internet par communication (chat/email/video call) aur roz-marra ki e-Services (learning, banking, shopping, reservation, governance) dono available hain — har ek ka apna specific use-case hai.
summary.en: The internet offers both communication (chat/email/video call) and everyday e-Services (learning, banking, shopping, reservation, governance) — each with its own specific use case.
